units.function: Codex-local environment diagnostic tests for working-directory readiness, native/API-key authentication signals and a Windows command-wrapper hello probe.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> @paperclipai/adapter-codex-local testEnvironment -> real temporary filesystem and, on Windows only, a fake executable resolved through PATH; no database, Secret service, authorization or durable audit layer.
units.keyDataModels: Company/adapter identity, engine/command/cwd/env configuration, CODEX_HOME auth.json, OPENAI_API_KEY/PATH and structured diagnostic status/check codes.
units.lifecycle: Operator requests environment test -> adapter may create missing cwd -> checks auth-file/API-key presence -> may spawn a hello probe -> returns structured checks and aggregate status.
units.testAssessment: On macOS, 3 tests passed and the single Windows-only probe test skipped. Stable diagnostic codes are a strong contract choice, but coverage is shallow: it proves path creation and auth-file existence, not credential validity, filesystem safety, process isolation, timeout/output controls, ACP behavior or failure modes.
units.designRationale: Give operators actionable preflight diagnostics across subscription auth and API-key setups, including Windows .cmd resolution, before assigning real work to a local Agent.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs Connector health/capability attestation that is secret-free, non-destructive by default, platform-aware and bound to an execution node, tenant and short validity window.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the stable check-code/result-envelope and cross-platform fixture pattern. Separate read-only diagnose from an explicit provision/remediate command; execute probes inside the local node boundary with path policy, credential-reference resolution, timeout/output limits and a short-lived signed attestation. Keep all Codex specifics in the Connector adapter.
units.responsibilityConflict: A diagnostic call can create a configured absolute directory without a distinct authorized action or evidence. Auth presence says nothing about which human/company authorized the external identity, its audience or data scope, so it cannot serve as a responsibility or readiness proof.
evidence: 2026-08-19 focused Vitest on macOS: 3 passed, 1 Windows-only test skipped
units.securityFindings: HIGH effect-boundary concern: a nominal environment diagnostic creates any configured absolute missing cwd, mixing observation and mutation. HIGH credential assurance gap: auth.json existence is accepted without checking regular-file/symlink status, containment, owner/mode, parsing, expiry, audience or revocation. MEDIUM command-resolution gap: the Windows test proves PATH wrapper execution but not hostile shadowing, command provenance/signature or allowlisting. Missing tests cover traversal/symlink races, wrong ownership, permission failures, hostile env, Secret references, probe timeout/cancel/output caps, malformed/secret-bearing output, concurrent tests and short-lived attestation.
